prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset: UI-ACTION-MANEUVER-ACTIVE, one raster action glyph variant.
Input image: edit target, original NORMAL icon. Keep its exact symbol geometry, orientation, center, scale, canvas size and transparent background. Do not add symbols, lettering, panel, shadow or decorative plate.
Change only state treatment: make the existing outer bronze edge a brighter warm gold, add a narrow clearly visible ivory outer keyline following the entire silhouette, keep inner ivory fill slightly less bright than normal. Active rim must be distinct and crisp; do not add a broad glow.
Transparent output with original alpha silhouette retained. The exact runtime opacity parameter will be set separately.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset: UI-ACTION-MANEUVER-DISABLED, one raster action glyph variant.
Input image: edit target, original NORMAL icon. Keep its exact symbol geometry, orientation, center, scale, canvas size and transparent background. Do not add symbols, lettering, panel, shadow or decorative plate.
Change only state treatment: desaturate all bronze to neutral grey; lower ivory face to a medium desaturated grey while preserving readable silhouette and all transparent gaps. Keep the edge subdued; remove warm gold accents. It should clearly read as unavailable while retaining icon identity.
Transparent output with original alpha silhouette retained. The exact runtime opacity parameter will be set separately.
